title: BugGen 2.0: Rethinking the Roles of LLMs for Scalable RTL Bug Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2611.23091v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-assisted RTL localization and debugging need ground-truth bug datasets with known locations and observable failures, while testbench grading uses injected bugs to measure detection capability. Creating such datasets at scale remains a major EDA challenge. BugGen 1.0 shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate context-aware RTL mutations. Still, it relies on the model for both choosing where to mutate and generating the edit, which increases inference costs and can lead to invalid choices. BugGen 2.0 changes this division of labor. Deterministic algorithms handle structural analysis, target selection, and validation, while the LLM focuses on localized semantic rewriting. Across four OpenTitan IP blocks and FabScalar with three LLMs, BugGen 2.0 reaches every requested quota of compilable bug scenarios that cause at least two test failures, with 14-16 of 16 configured mutation types represented. translated_title: BugGen 2.0：重新思考大语言模型在可扩展RTL缺陷合成中的角色
translated_abstract: AI辅助的RTL（寄存器传输级）定位与调试需要具有已知缺陷位置和可观测故障的真实缺陷数据集，而测试平台评级则使用注入的缺陷来衡量检测能力。大规模创建此类数据集仍然是EDA领域的一项重大挑战。BugGen 1.0证明了大语言模型（LLM）能够生成具有上下文感知能力的RTL变异，但它同时依赖模型来选择变异位置和生成编辑内容，这增加了推理成本，并可能导致无效的选择。BugGen 2.0改变了这种分工方式：确定性算法负责结构分析、目标选择和验证，而LLM则专注于局部语义改写。在四个OpenTitan IP模块和FabScalar上结合三种LLM的实验中，BugGen 2.0达到了所有请求的配额，生成了可编译且导致至少两次测试失败的缺陷场景，并且16种配置的变异类型中有14-16种得到体现。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: BugGen 2.0重新划分了LLM与确定性算法的分工，由算法负责RTL缺陷的结构分析、目标选择与验证，LLM专注于局部语义改写，从而实现高效可靠的大规模RTL缺陷数据集自动生成。
en_tdlr: BugGen 2.0 rethinks the division of labor by letting deterministic algorithms handle structural analysis, target selection, and validation while LLMs focus solely on localized semantic rewriting, enabling scalable and reliable RTL bug dataset synthesis.
